integration_notes.apps/voice_chat/application.py: Explicit USB devices and product robot/vision factories; private cancellable provisioning; cancel per-session tasks and suppress callbacks after shutdown. Optional no-audio factory and pre-provisioned binding/credentials allow headless MCP before USB audio exists. Local wake feedback drains before cloud handshake/capture, including failed connections; cancellation prevents opening a channel after shutdown. Forward per-App prebuffer/output-latency settings; SDK defaults retained. Forward optional capture transforms to chat and wake workers. Forward optional product PCM/DAC observers to the audio codec; disabled by default in the SDK. Forward optional input-latency requests; the unconfigured SDK keeps the device default. Forward optional per-model wake preprocessing and cadence; overridable local wake cue preserves pre-cloud playback/drain ordering. Pass product channel count and mono selector into capture and wake-word streams. Preserve full-duplex render-reference continuity at normal TTS start/end; explicit interruptions/timeouts still reset. See provenance/local-aec.json. Recognize the verified cloud abort reply-ID variant separately from normal completion: flush DAC immediately without resetting cloud speech capture; generations prevent old drain waiters from clearing a new answer.
integration_notes.apps/voice_chat/audio_codec.py: Explicit input/output devices; App-local Opus resolution; software volume before AEC reference. Optional per-App network prebuffer and hardware output latency; defer callback logging; report buffer/underflow counters; wait for DAC tail, flush hardware on interruption and discard stale decode/WAV/PLC work. Optional product capture transform runs once after AEC in the capture worker; SDK default remains unity. Optional product output observer receives final speaker PCM and DAC timing through a bounded append-only callback; PCM flush cancels future product targets. SDK defaults remain disabled. Bounded product local PCM playback requires an idle running output, shares existing output transform/AEC, and returns a reset generation ticket. DAC-tail accounting is atomic with PCM consumption. Input callbacks enqueue bounded near blocks and far-sequence watermarks only; the capture worker handles reference resampling, AEC alignment and debug dumps. Hardware overflow or dropped callback sequences re-anchor the reference. Capture generations reject in-flight frames after pause/close; reference generations discard held blocks after all audio resets. Optional validated input latency and actual latency/callback/worker/queue diagnostics; SDK default remains unchanged. Local WAV and local PCM cue byte ranges mask only the optional TTS lip-sync observer, including mixed callbacks and preserved PCM at tts:start; speaker samples, gains, AEC reference and DAC timing remain unchanged. Full PCM flush also discards cue ranges. Optional native stereo capture is reduced explicitly to mono in the worker before AEC; Opus remains mono. Preserve full-duplex render-reference continuity at normal TTS start/end; explicit interruptions/timeouts still reset. See provenance/local-aec.json.
integration_notes.apps/voice_chat/ota.py: Private App state; stable device identity; UNO Q product metadata; cancellable provisioning.
integration_notes.apps/voice_chat/mcp_server.py: Run camera, Duck IPC, volume and system queries in executor threads. Preserve standard MCP error content and include the detailed error field consumed by deployed Xiaozhi clouds.
integration_notes.apps/voice_chat/iot/thing.py: Invocation-local parameters for concurrent MCP/IoT calls.
integration_notes.apps/ai/wakeword_manager.py: Vendored model root; one ONNX thread; explicit USB input; honour cancellation after model load/inference. Convert normalized capture to PCM16 amplitude range required by the identical upstream mel graph. Optional product capture transform runs once in the inference worker, outside the PortAudio callback. Optional per-model normalized input (scale 1), inference stride and cooldown; legacy PCM16 scale/500ms defaults retained. Normalized-profile inference reuses only byte-identical mel windows in a 32-entry bounded embedding cache, cleared on model reload; changed windows run the original graph. Reports per-window inference time. Explicit mono/stereo capture, 320 ms input latency, bounded timestamped queue and discontinuity reset. Callback copies/counts only; worker handles audio sidecars and logs.
integration_notes.libs/__init__.py: Empty namespace for headless SDK integration; desktop libraries are not bundled.
integration_notes.apps/voice_chat/mqtt_udp_protocol.py: Reject closed/stale MQTT callbacks; serialize client creation and shutdown; cancel reconnect tasks and disconnect before joining old network threads.
